package_info.why_malicious: No specific malicious package or code is described in this report. The article discusses trends in software supply chain attacks and the increased risk from third-party software, but does not analyze or identify any particular malicious package or code sample.

behavioral_signatures: Sudden increase in third-party software supply chain attacks
Exploitation of unpatched vulnerabilities in web applications
Rapid scanning for exploitable vulnerabilities (within 5 days of disclosure)

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for the use of unvetted or untrusted third-party software components, track vulnerability patch status (especially in web applications), and watch for rapid exploitation attempts following public vulnerability disclosures. Employ SBOMs and automated analysis tools to gain transparency into third-party software components.
